notes: latest: the newest Windows build. minimum: older builds must update before playing online. Raise both when you ship a build with code changes; card-only changes need neither (the game downloads new cards itself). patchBase: the oldest full build a patch (downloads/AlleywayBrawlers-<latest>-patch.pck) can update in place; raise it with a full build when project settings or autoloads change. macos.patchBase: the same for the Mac build (patches: downloads/AlleywayBrawlers-<latest>-patch-macos.pck, full builds -macos.zip); Mac and Windows share latest and minimum, so they always play each other.
